title: Measure internet censorship
summary: OONI (Open Observatory of Network Interference) is a free software project that measures internet censorship and network interference by running tests to detect blocked websites and traffic manipulation. It provides global, crowdsourced data on internet restrictions worldwide.
problem_solved: Detecting and documenting internet censorship and network interference in real-time across different countries.
why_valuable: Provides transparency and evidence-based data on internet freedom violations, helping researchers, journalists, and activists understand global censorship patterns.
